meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会成为 5 人对抗团队的 Lead:成员互相攻击彼此的结论,只留下经得起质疑的洞见,再交给专职规划器写成计划。启动时先喊「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批评的计划时触发。需 team 工具可用且当前是顶层会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移。
say.note: 先组 5 人对抗团队,再产出计划。

say.text: 对这个方案做一次对抗式交叉批评,再给我最终计划。
say.note: 成员互相攻击后只保留站得住的部分。

say.text: 让团队成员互相挑刺,把经得起质疑的结论交给规划器成文。
say.note: 最后一步由专职规划器写计划。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member hostile team: members attack each other's findings, only defensible insights survive, then a dedicated planner formalizes them. It first says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!".
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan. Requires the team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration.
Cross-critique this plan adversarially, then give me the final one.
say_en.note: Only defensible parts survive the attacks.

say_en.text: Have the team pick apart each other's findings before formalizing.
say_en.note: A dedicated planner writes the final plan.
